IFCAT-008.note: CLI launch/discovery/execution lookup have versioned JSON (schemaVersion 1), help/exit and malformed-input tests. SIGINT/SIGTERM cancel the primary cleanly (event loop exit, normal teardown, lock released) with documented exit 130/143; arguments alone choose operation and output mode (no XERAHS_* environment switches; XDG_* only locates the profile); the stdout/stderr ownership and exit-code tables are in app/CLI-CONTRACT.md. Wait/cancel/live-progress CLI commands are not part of this row's text (see IFCAT-006 and WORKFLOW-CLI.md). Audit 2026-11-03: stable names: CliContractTest::standardStreamsFollowTheOwnershipTable(help) lists every flag; precedence: CliContractTest::environmentCannotSelectOperationOrOutputMode; stdout/stderr ownership: CliContractTest::standardStreamsFollowTheOwnershipTable (11 modes); exit codes 0/1/2: NativeInstanceTest::actualApplicationForwardsWorkflowIdsAndReportsOnlyDelivery, 130/143: CliContractTest::primaryExitsWithDocumentedStatusOnSigintAndSigterm plus TerminationSignalsTest (three cases); non-interactive: NativeInstanceTest::workflowCliRefusesMalformedHeadlessAndMissingProfilesWithoutSideEffects; versioned JSON: schemaVersion assertions in both suites. Rationale: arguments-only CLI and 128+signal follow the reference XerahS/ShareX daemons and Unix shell convention.

IFCAT-009.note: Non-interactive refusal is generic: any graphical operation (every capture source, edit, run-workflow, all recording commands and a plain launch) returns presentation-required (exit 1, fixed actionable text, requestId only) before QApplication, display, instance election, preferences or portal consent, and never forwards to a running instance. Read-only list/result commands never prompt. No current CLI command takes credentials or destructive approval, so those cases cannot arise until such commands exist. Audit 2026-11-03: each operation refused with presentation-required and no side effects: NativeInstanceTest::workflowCliRefusesMalformedHeadlessAndMissingProfilesWithoutSideEffects (rows run-workflow, capture-region, capture-full-screen, capture-monitor, capture-active-window, start-recording, stop-recording, region-recording-headless, edit, plain-launch; checks stable code, actionable stderr 'No operation was started.', no leaked argument, no display/profile/instance access); not forwarded to a live owner: NativeInstanceTest::nonInteractiveNeverForwardsToARunningOwnerOrPerformsTheOperation (all eight actions plus plain launch). Rationale: refusal over prompting matches ShareX/Flameshot headless behavior.

IFCAT-010.note: Explicit CLI metadata excludes paths/settings/payloads and uses fixed diagnostics in actual-process tests. Every CLI mode (help, list, result lookup, all refusals, usage errors, forwarded launches in accepted/busy/rejected/unknown-delivery states) is redacted by default; the CLI has no verbose or diagnostic flag (they are refused as usage-invalid) and diagnostic environment settings cannot weaken redaction. Redaction rules are in app/CLI-CONTRACT.md. Audit 2026-11-03: CliContractTest::redactionHoldsInEveryCliModeEvenWithDiagnosticSettings (58 rows incl. every operation flag with and without --json, corrupt and valid secret-laden profiles, secret arguments and environment, QT_LOGGING_RULES/XERAHS_VERBOSE diagnostic variants, JSON fields limited to the stable set); NativeInstanceTest::workflowDiscoveryIsHeadlessReadOnlyAndDoesNotActivatePrimary keeps the per-field privacy assertions. CLI output carries no capture content or account data by construction.
